title: Independent Experiment, Implementation, and Claim Audit Report

governance_and_integrity.frozen_reference_architecture: SmallCNN1D (K=12, C=6, W=128, stride=64, 283,692 parameters, 1,136,072 bytes)

key_dispositions.H01: VERIFIED_FINITE — 5,034 adjacent within-recording test pairs verified; 12 intermediate Conv1D feature positions bitwise equal.
key_dispositions.H02: FALSIFIED_UNCONDITIONAL — 50% temporal overlap exhibits large coordinate deltas under continuous motion.
key_dispositions.H03: FALSIFIED_UNCONDITIONAL — Witness row 682->683 changes model predictions despite identical WALKING_DOWNSTAIRS label.
key_dispositions.H13: VERIFIED_FINITE — Exact intermediate Conv1D/BN/Pool feature reuse preserves bitwise classifier decision (A_reuse = 1.0).
key_dispositions.H14: FALSIFIED_UNCONDITIONAL — Incremental computation yields negative net savings (-463.47%) due to tensor slicing overhead on CPU batch=1.
key_dispositions.H19: FALSIFIED_UNCONDITIONAL — Mathematical certification yields 0 useful streaming hits on continuous sensor stream under valid budgets.
key_dispositions.H20: FALSIFIED_UNCONDITIONAL — 100% within-recording coverage does not yield speedup (speed ratio 0.1775x vs M00 core).
key_dispositions.H21: NOT_ESTABLISHED — Frozen SmallCNN1D M00 core remains superior on CPU; LipCache audited unsupported.
key_dispositions.H24: NOT_ESTABLISHED — 0 of 17 methods satisfy Soundness AND Useful Coverage AND Net Speedup.

findings.title: Exploratory Test Exposure Disclosed
findings.description: Full test stream was exposed during Week 1-3 baseline establishment. Week 4 operated under strict pre-test protocol seal, with KNOWN_TEST_EXPLORATORY exposure level declared in all artifacts.

findings.title: Authentic Negative Results Preserved
findings.description: All negative results (H02, H03, H07, H14, H15, H19, H20, H22, H23, H24) were strictly reported without fabricating speedups or inflating baseline overhead.

findings.title: A_reuse Null Rule Strictly Enforced
findings.description: When reuse count R = 0, A_reuse is reported as null / N/A, preventing false claims of 100% agreement when no queries were accepted by the certificate.
